mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageNumber}
OFFSET #{pageNumber} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_TYPE = #{assetType} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_CATEGORY = #{assetCategory} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_NATURE = #{assetNature} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_STATUS = #{assetStatus} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_REGION = #{assetRegion} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_INDUSTRY = #{assetIndustry} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL = #{assetQualityLevel} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_RISK_LEVEL = #{assetRiskLevel} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE IS_CORE_ASSET = #{isCoreAsset} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ORIGINAL_VALUE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE IS_STRATEGIC_ASSET = #{isStrategicAsset} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ORIGINAL_VALUE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE IS_IDLE_ASSET = #{isIdleAsset} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE IS_PLEDGED = #{isPledged} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE NEED_REGULATORY_ATTENTION = #{needRegulatoryAttention} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_MANAGER = #{assetManager} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE MANAGEMENT_DEPARTMENT = #{managementDepartment} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT ASSET_TYPE as assetType, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalOriginalValue, SUM(NET_VALUE) as totalNetValue, SUM(MARKET_VALUE) as totalMarketValue, AVG(ASSET_RETURN_RATE) as avgReturnRate, AVG(ASSET_TURNOVER_RATE) as avgTurnoverRate, AVG(ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE) as avgUtilizationRate FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_TYPE ORDER BY totalOriginalValue DESC

SELECT ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL as qualityLevel, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, AVG(ASSET_RETURN_RATE) as avgReturnRate, AVG(ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE) as avgUtilizationRate FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL WHEN 'EXCELLENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'GOOD' THEN 2 WHEN 'AVERAGE' THEN 3 WHEN 'POOR' THEN 4 WHEN 'BAD' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT ASSET_TYPE as assetType, ASSET_CATEGORY as assetCategory, COUNT(*) as assetCount, AVG(ASSET_RETURN_RATE) as avgReturnRate, AVG(ASSET_TURNOVER_RATE) as avgTurnoverRate, AVG(ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE) as avgUtilizationRate, AVG(ASSET_OUTPUT_EFFICIENCY) as avgOutputEfficiency FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_TYPE, ASSET_CATEGORY ORDER BY avgReturnRate DESC

SELECT ASSET_TYPE as assetType, AVG(ASSET_RETURN_RATE) as avgReturnRate, MAX(ASSET_RETURN_RATE) as maxReturnRate, MIN(ASSET_RETURN_RATE) as minReturnRate, COUNT(*) as assetCount FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 AND ASSET_RETURN_RATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ASSET_TYPE ORDER BY avgReturnRate DESC

SELECT ASSET_TYPE as assetType, AVG(ASSET_TURNOVER_RATE) as avgTurnoverRate, MAX(ASSET_TURNOVER_RATE) as maxTurnoverRate, MIN(ASSET_TURNOVER_RATE) as minTurnoverRate, COUNT(*) as assetCount FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 AND ASSET_TURNOVER_RATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ASSET_TYPE ORDER BY avgTurnoverRate DESC

SELECT ASSET_TYPE as assetType, AVG(ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE) as avgUtilizationRate, MAX(ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE) as maxUtilizationRate, MIN(ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE) as minUtilizationRate, COUNT(*) as assetCount FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 AND ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ASSET_TYPE ORDER BY avgUtilizationRate DESC

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m') as dateMonth,
TO_CHAR(CREATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM') as dateMonth,
SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalOriginalValue, SUM(NET_VALUE) as totalNetValue, SUM(MARKET_VALUE) as totalMarketValue, COUNT(*) as assetCount FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0
AND CREATE_TIME >= #{startDate}
AND CREATE_TIME <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m')
TO_CHAR(CREATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY dateMonth

SELECT ASSET_ID as assetId, ASSET_NAME as assetName, ASSET_TYPE as assetType, ORIGINAL_VALUE as originalValue, NET_VALUE as netValue, MARKET_VALUE as marketValue, ASSET_RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel, ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL as qualityLevel, (ORIGINAL_VALUE - NET_VALUE) / ORIGINAL_VALUE * 100 as depreciationRate FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 AND (ASSET_RISK_LEVEL IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') OR ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL IN ('POOR', 'BAD') OR (ORIGINAL_VALUE > 0 AND (ORIGINAL_VALUE - NET_VALUE) / ORIGINAL_VALUE > 0.8)) ORDER BY depreciationRate DESC

SELECT ASSET_TYPE as assetType, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_TYPE ORDER BY assetCount DESC

SELECT ASSET_CATEGORY as assetCategory, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_CATEGORY ORDER BY assetCount DESC

SELECT ASSET_NATURE as assetNature, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_NATURE ORDER BY assetCount DESC

SELECT ASSET_STATUS as assetStatus, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_STATUS ORDER BY assetCount DESC

SELECT ASSET_REGION as assetRegion, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 AND ASSET_REGION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ASSET_REGION ORDER BY assetCount DESC

SELECT ASSET_INDUSTRY as assetIndustry, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 AND ASSET_INDUSTRY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ASSET_INDUSTRY ORDER BY assetCount DESC

SELECT ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL as qualityLevel, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL WHEN 'EXCELLENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'GOOD' THEN 2 WHEN 'AVERAGE' THEN 3 WHEN 'POOR' THEN 4 WHEN 'BAD' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT ASSET_RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_RISK_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE ASSET_RISK_LEVEL WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT MAINTENANCE_CONDITION as maintenanceCondition, COUNT(*) as assetCount, AVG(ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE) as avgUtilizationRate FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY MAINTENANCE_CONDITION

SELECT INSURANCE_STATUS as insuranceStatus, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(INSURANCE_AMOUNT) as totalInsuranceAmount FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY INSURANCE_STATUS

SELECT TECHNICAL_CONDITION as technicalCondition, COUNT(*) as assetCount, AVG(ASSET_OUTPUT_EFFICIENCY) as avgOutputEfficiency FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY TECHNICAL_CONDITION

SELECT DEPRECIATION_METHOD as depreciationMethod, COUNT(*) as assetCount, AVG(DEPRECIATION_RATE) as avgDepreciationRate, SUM(ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION) as totalAccumulatedDepreciation FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY DEPRECIATION_METHOD

SELECT ASSET_REGION as assetRegion, COUNT(*) as assetCount, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalValue, ROUND(SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0), 2) as concentrationRatio FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_REGION ORDER BY totalValue DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE ASSET_RISK_LEVEL = #{riskLevel} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalAssets, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as totalOriginalValue, SUM(NET_VALUE) as totalNetValue, SUM(MARKET_VALUE) as totalMarketValue, AVG(ASSET_RETURN_RATE) as avgReturnRate, AVG(ASSET_TURNOVER_RATE) as avgTurnoverRate, AVG(ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE) as avgUtilizationRate, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_CORE_ASSET = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as coreAssetCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_STRATEGIC_ASSET = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as strategicAssetCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_IDLE_ASSET = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as idleAssetCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_PLEDGED = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pledgedAssetCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ASSET_RISK_LEVEL IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as highRiskAssetCount FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0
SELECT ASSET_TYPE as type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as value FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT ASSET_NATURE as nature, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as value FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_NATURE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT ASSET_STATUS as status, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as value FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL as qualityLevel, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as value FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL WHEN 'EXCELLENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'GOOD' THEN 2 WHEN 'AVERAGE' THEN 3 WHEN 'POOR' THEN 4 WHEN 'BAD' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT ASSET_RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) as value FROM ASSET_INFO WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ASSET_RISK_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE ASSET_RISK_LEVEL WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT ASSET_ID as assetId, ASSET_CODE as assetCode, ASSET_NAME as assetName, ENTERPRISE_NAME as enterpriseName, ASSET_TYPE as assetType, ASSET_CATEGORY as assetCategory, ASSET_NATURE as assetNature, ASSET_STATUS as assetStatus, ORIGINAL_VALUE as originalValue, NET_VALUE as netValue, MARKET_VALUE as marketValue, ASSET_RETURN_RATE as returnRate, ASSET_TURNOVER_RATE as turnoverRate, ASSET_UTILIZATION_RATE as utilizationRate, ASSET_QUALITY_LEVEL as qualityLevel, ASSET_RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel, ASSET_LOCATION as location, ASSET_REGION as region, ASSET_INDUSTRY as industry, ASSET_MANAGER as manager, MANAGEMENT_DEPARTMENT as department, ACQUISITION_DATE as acquisitionDate, CREATE_TIME as createTime FROM ASSET_INFO
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
